name: LangChain: Scaffold contribution
description: Engineer workflow — Composer — runs /scaffold-contribution skill. Writes code and unit tests.

prompts:
Run the LangChain Onboarding Kit **scaffold-contribution** workflow.

**Model:** This automation is pinned to Composer. Do not change model for this run.

**Instructions:** Read and follow `.cursor/skills/scaffold-contribution/SKILL.md` in this repository in full.

**Input:** Load a plan from `.cursor/plans/` (prefer `latest` unless the user names a file). If no plans exist, ask which package and task to implement (default demo: small util + unit tests in `libs/partners/anthropic/`).

**Gates:** Run `.cursor/scripts/pre_pr.sh <package-path> "<proposed-pr-title>"` before finishing.

**Cross-model rule:** Do NOT run `/review-before-pr` in this session. When done, tell the user to run **LangChain: Review before PR** (Sonnet) in a **new automation run** for independent verification.
